chapter_note: Highly substratic chapter: systematic enumeration of twelve cosmic judges, each mapped to a cosmic figure (First Man, Living Spirit, Mother of Life, King of Honor, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Virgin of Light, Mind of Light, Great Counsel/Call+Hearing). Pure cosmos→cosmos correspondential structure. Editorial frame minimal: opening dialogue formula (i=3) and concluding hortatory pastoral block (i=76-83) with vocative 'my beloved ones' and judgment exhortation. The fatigue score (+1.24) correctly identifies the late hortatory tail.
